17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 6941-57 South Western Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: C2-2 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District
Lot Area: 50,491 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to establish a uniform zoning district and permit
a proposed one-story addition, containing approximately 4,193 sq. ft. of
floor area, to the existing one-story commercial building. Pursuant to Sec.
17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and
pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-II and 17-13-1101 of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to modify/waive the Fencing Standards
of Sec. 17-11-0601, modify/waive the Screening of Vehicular Use Areas
from Streets requirements of Sec. 17-11-0602, modify/waive the Parkway
Trees Standards od Sec. 17-11-0603, waive the 7.5% interior landscaping
requirement, and all relief necessary, as allowed by the Code, for the Type-
1 plan set..

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 22,317 square feet (0.44 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): No dwelling units proposed

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 84 parking spaces total (5 customer parking spaces
and 79 employee and vehicle inventory parking spaces)

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 0 ft. (existing)
b. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 0 ft. (existing)
East Side: 0 ft. (existing)
c Rear Setback: 0 ft. (existing)

(E) Building Height: 21 ft.
